The api died because the disk filled up: at 03:14:00 the database hit "No space left on device" on `/var/lib/stockroom`, the api aborted its transaction, shut down its worker pool and exited with status 1 at 03:14:06. It never came back; the proxy logs "upstream api refused connection" every two minutes from 03:16 until the log ends at 05:29:57, with no api restart in between.

The disk was filled by the `report-export` job, which started at 03:05:00 and wrote a 512 MB CSV to `/var/lib/stockroom/exports/` every 12 seconds, 40 files (about 20 GB) by 03:12:48. Disk warnings fired at 91% (03:09:03) and 99% (03:13:30) before the database failed. The job shares a volume with the database, and nothing stopped it or acted on the warnings.

To recover, free space in `/var/lib/stockroom/exports/` and start the api again. To stop a repeat, move the exports to a different volume from the database or cap the job's output. Nothing in this repo defines `report-export`, so that fix belongs wherever the job is scheduled.

The log's timestamps are all 2026-03-09, not last night, so check this is the right file for the outage you mean. The `cache: slow command` warnings run at a steady rate through the whole log and look unrelated, and web and proxy kept serving 200s throughout.
